import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Filter data for the top 10 most common breeds
top_breeds = data['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().nlargest(10).index
filtered_data = data[data['Rasse1Text'].isin(top_breeds)]

# Create a count plot for the top 10 breeds
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.countplot(data=filtered_data, y='Rasse1Text', hue='SexLang', order=top_breeds, palette='Set2')

# Customizing the plot
plt.title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich by Gender')
plt.xlabel('Number of Dogs')
plt.ylabel('Dog Breeds')
plt.legend(title='Gender')
plt.grid(axis='x')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
